local function renameVars(toks)

		["ipairs"]=1,["next"]=1,["select"]=1,["unpack"]=1,["rawget"]=1,

		["wait"]=1,["spawn"]=1,["delay"]=1,["typeof"]=1,["warn"]=1,
		["tick"]=1,["time"]=1,["collectgarbage"]=1,
	}

	local nameMap = {}

	local function getTok(i)
		while toks[i] and toks[i].type == "newline" do i=i+1 end
		return toks[i], i
	end

	local function collectLocals()
		local i=1
		while i<=#toks do
			local t, nxt = getTok(i)
			if not t then break end
			i = nxt
			
			if t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="local" then
				local nj = i+1
				local t2, j = getTok(nj)
				if t2 and t2.type=="keyword" and t2.value=="function" then
					local t3, k = getTok(j+1)
					if t3 and t3.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[t3.value] then
						if not nameMap[t3.value] then nameMap[t3.value]=newVar() end
					end
				elseif t2 and t2.type=="identifier" then
					while t2 and t2.type=="identifier" do
						if not PROTECTED[t2.value] and not nameMap[t2.value] then
							nameMap[t2.value]=newVar()
						end
						local tComma, nk = getTok(j+1)
						if tComma and tComma.type=="punctuation" and tComma.value=="," then
							t2, j = getTok(nk+1)
						else break end
					end
				end
			elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then
				local nj = i+1
				local tj, j = getTok(nj)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value=="(") do
					tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				end
				tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value==")") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then
						nameMap[tj.value]=newVar()
					end
					tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				end
			elseif (t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for") then
				local nj = i+1
				local tj, j = getTok(nj)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="keyword" and tj.value=="in") and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value=="=") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then
						nameMap[tj.value]=newVar()
					end
					local tComma, nk = getTok(j+1)
					if tComma and tComma.type=="punctuation" and tComma.value=="," then
						tj, j = getTok(nk+1)
					else break end
				end
			end
			i=i+1
		end
	end
		collectLocals()

	local result = {}
	for _,t in ipairs(toks) do
		if t.type=="identifier" and nameMap[t.value] then
			local newName = nameMap[t.value]
			t.value = newName
			t.raw = newName
			t.length = #newName
			result[#result+1]=t
		else
			result[#result+1]=t
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function parseAST(toks)
	local tp=1
	local function T()
		while toks[tp] and toks[tp].type == "newline" do tp = tp + 1 end
		return toks[tp] or {type="eof", value="EOF", raw="EOF"}
	end
	local function Tt() return T().type end
	local function Tv() return T().value end
	local function Pt(n)
		local tmp = tp
		local c = 0
		while true do
			while toks[tmp] and toks[tmp].type == "newline" do tmp = tmp + 1 end
			c = c + 1
			if c >= n then break end
			tmp = tmp + 1
		end
		local x = toks[tmp]
		return x and x.type or "eof"
	end
	local function Pv(n)
		local tmp = tp
		local c = 0
		while true do
			while toks[tmp] and toks[tmp].type == "newline" do tmp = tmp + 1 end
			c = c + 1
			if c >= n then break end
			tmp = tmp + 1
		end
		local x = toks[tmp]
		return x and x.value or ""
	end
	local function adv()
		tp=tp+1
		while toks[tp] and toks[tp].type == "newline" do tp = tp + 1 end
	end
	local function chk(t,v) if v then return T().type==t and T().value==v end return T().type==t end
	local function eat(t,v)
		if not chk(t,v) then error("Expected "..t..(v and " '"..v.."'" or "").." got "..T().type.." '"..tostring(T().value).."'") end
		local r=T(); adv(); return r
	end
	local function try(t,v) if chk(t,v) then adv(); return true end end

	local parseExpr,parseStat,parseBlock,parseFB

	local BOPS={["or"]=1,["and"]=2,["<"]=3,[">"]=3,["<="]=3,[">="]=3,["=="]=3,["~="]=3,
		[".."]=4,["+"]=5,["-"]=5,["*"]=6,["/"]=6,["%"]=6,["//"]=6,["^"]=7}
	local RASS={["^"]=true,[".."]=true}
	local ENDS={["end"]=1,["else"]=1,["elseif"]=1,["until"]=1,["eof"]=1}

	local function pSfx(base)
		while true do
			if chk("punctuation",".") then
				adv(); local f=eat("identifier").value
				base = { type="MemberExpression", base=base, identifier=f }
			elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
				adv(); local idx=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]")
				base = { type="IndexExpression", base=base, index=idx }
			elseif chk("punctuation",":") then
				adv(); local m=eat("identifier").value
				eat("punctuation","(")
				local args={}
				if not chk("punctuation",")") then
					args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
				end
				eat("punctuation",")")
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, method=m, arguments=args, isSelf=true }
			elseif chk("punctuation","(") then
				adv(); local args={}
				if not chk("punctuation",")") then
					args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
				end
				eat("punctuation",")")
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments=args, isSelf=false }
			elseif chk("string") then
				local sv=T().value; adv()
				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments={{type="Literal", kind="string", value=sv}}, isSelf=false }
					elseif chk("punctuation","{") then
			adv()
			local fields={}
			while not chk("punctuation","}") do
				if chk("identifier") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
					local k=T().value; adv(); adv()
					fields[#fields+1]={ key={type="Literal", kind="string", value=k}, value=parseExpr() }
				elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
					adv(); local k=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]"); eat("punctuation","=")
					fields[#fields+1]={ key=k, value=parseExpr() }
				else fields[#fields+1]={ key=nil, value=parseExpr() } end
				if not try("punctuation",",") then try("punctuation",";") end
			end
			eat("punctuation","}")
			base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments={{type="TableLiteral", fields=fields}}, isSelf=false }
			else break end
		end
		return base
	end

	local function pPrim()
		local t=T()
		if t.type=="number" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="number", value=tonumber(t.value) }
		elseif t.type=="string" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="string", value=t.value }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="true" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=true }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="false" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=false }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="nil" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="nil", value=nil }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="..." then adv(); return { type="VarargLiteral" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then adv(); return parseFB()
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(" then
			adv(); local e=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation",")"); return pSfx(e)
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="not" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="not", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="-" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="-", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="#" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="#", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="~" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="~", argument=pPrim() }
				elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="{" then
			adv()
			local fields={}
			while not chk("punctuation","}") do
				if chk("identifier") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
					local k=T().value; adv(); adv()
					fields[#fields+1]={ key={type="Literal", kind="string", value=k}, value=parseExpr() }
				elseif chk("punctuation","[") then
					adv(); local k=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation","]"); eat("punctuation","=")
					fields[#fields+1]={ key=k, value=parseExpr() }
				else fields[#fields+1]={ key=nil, value=parseExpr() } end
				if not try("punctuation",",") then try("punctuation",";") end
			end
			eat("punctuation","}")
			return { type="TableLiteral", fields=fields }
		elseif t.type=="identifier" then
			local n=t.value; adv()
			return pSfx({ type="Identifier", name=n })
		else error("Unexpected token in expression: "..t.type.." '"..t.value.."'") end
	end

		parseExpr = function(mp)
		mp=mp or 0
		local node=pPrim()
		while true do
			local op=T().value
			local pr=BOPS[op]
			if not pr or pr<=mp then break end
			
			if (op=="+" or op=="-" or op=="*" or op=="/" or op=="%" or op=="^" or op=="..") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
				break
			end
			
			adv()
			local np2=RASS[op] and pr-1 or pr
			local right=parseExpr(np2)
			node={ type="BinaryExpression", operator=op, left=node, right=right }
		end
		return node
	end

	parseFB = function()
		eat("punctuation","(")
		local params={}; local isva=false
		while not chk("punctuation",")") do
			if chk("punctuation","...") then isva=true; adv(); break end
			params[#params+1]=eat("identifier").value; try("punctuation",",")
		end
		eat("punctuation",")")
		local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
		return { type="FunctionDefinition", params=params, isVararg=isva, body=body }
	end

	parseStat = function()
		local t=T()
		if t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="local" then
			adv()

			else

				while try("punctuation",",") do names[#names+1]=eat("identifier").value end
				local values={}
				if try("punctuation","=") then
					values[#values+1]=parseExpr()
					while try("punctuation",",") do values[#values+1]=parseExpr() end
				end
				return { type="LocalDefinition", names=names, values=values }
			end
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then
			adv(); local n=eat("identifier").value; local chain={n}
			while chk("punctuation",".") do adv(); chain[#chain+1]=eat("identifier").value end
			local isM=false
			if chk("punctuation",":") then adv(); chain[#chain+1]=eat("identifier").value; isM=true end
			local fb=parseFB()
			return { type="GlobalFunctionDefinition", chain=chain, isMethod=isM, functionDef=fb }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="return" then
			adv(); local args={}
			if not ENDS[Tv()] and not chk("punctuation",";") then
				args[#args+1]=parseExpr()
				while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
			end
			try("punctuation",";")
			return { type="ReturnStatement", arguments=args }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="if" then
			adv(); local clauses={}
			clauses[#clauses+1]={ condition=parseExpr(), body=parseBlock() }
			while chk("keyword","elseif") do
				adv(); clauses[#clauses+1]={ condition=parseExpr(), body=parseBlock() }
			end
			local elseBody=nil
			if try("keyword","else") then elseBody=parseBlock() end
			eat("keyword","end")
			return { type="IfStatement", clauses=clauses, elseBody=elseBody }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="while" then
			adv(); local cond=parseExpr(); eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
			return { type="WhileStatement", condition=cond, body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="repeat" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","until"); local cond=parseExpr()
			return { type="RepeatUntilStatement", body=body, condition=cond }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for" then
			adv(); local vn=eat("identifier").value
			if try("punctuation","=") then
				local start=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation",","); local limit=parseExpr(); local step=nil
				if try("punctuation",",") then step=parseExpr() end
				eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
				return { type="ForNumericStatement", variable=vn, start=start, limit=limit, step=step, body=body }
			else
				local names={vn}
				while not chk("keyword","in") do try("punctuation",","); if chk("identifier") then names[#names+1]=eat("identifier").value end end
				eat("keyword","in"); local iters={}
				iters[#iters+1]=parseExpr()
				while try("punctuation",",") do iters[#iters+1]=parseExpr() end
				eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
				return { type="ForGenericStatement", variables=names, iterators=iters, body=body }
			end
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="do" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end"); return { type="DoStatement", body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="break" then
			adv(); return { type="BreakStatement" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="continue" then
			adv(); return { type="ContinueStatement" }
						elseif t.type=="identifier" or (t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(") then
			local firstExpr = parseExpr()
			local isCompound = false
			local cOp = ""
			local nxtVal = T().value
			
			if (nxtVal=="+" or nxtVal=="-" or nxtVal=="*" or nxtVal=="/" or nxtVal=="%" or nxtVal=="^" or nxtVal=="..") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then
				isCompound = true
				cOp = nxtVal
				adv(); adv()
			end

			if isCompound then
				local rhs = { parseExpr() }
				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				try("punctuation",";")
				rhs[1] = { type="BinaryExpression", operator=cOp, left=firstExpr, right=rhs[1] }
				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs={firstExpr}, rhs=rhs }
			elseif chk("punctuation","=") or chk("punctuation",",") then
				local lhs = { firstExpr }
				while try("punctuation",",") do lhs[#lhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				eat("punctuation","=")
				local rhs = { parseExpr() }
				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				try("punctuation",";")
				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs }
			else
				try("punctuation",";")
				return { type="ExpressionStatement", expression=firstExpr }
			end
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value==";" then adv()
		else adv() end
		try("punctuation",";")
	end

	parseBlock = function()
		local block = {}
		while Tt()~="eof" and not (Tt()=="keyword" and ENDS[Tv()]) do
			local s=parseStat()
			if s then block[#block+1]=s end

local function peepholeOptimize(proto, OC)
	local superMap = {}
	local superCount = 0
	local usedOpcodes = {}
	for _, val in pairs(OC) do usedOpcodes[val] = true end

			local function fop()
		local val
		repeat val = math.random(1, 65535) until not usedOpcodes[val]
		usedOpcodes[val] = true
		return val
	end

		local reverseOC = {}
	for k, v in pairs(OC) do reverseOC[v] = k end

	local function getName(val)
		return reverseOC[val]
	end

	local safeOpMap = {}
		local function isSafeFast(op)
		if safeOpMap[op] ~= nil then return safeOpMap[op] end
		local opName = reverseOC[op]
		if opName and string.sub(opName, 1, 8) == "M_SUPER_" then 
			safeOpMap[op] = false
			return false 
		end
		local safe = op ~= OC.M_JMP and op ~= OC.M_TEST and op ~= OC.M_EQ and 
					 op ~= OC.M_LT and op ~= OC.M_LE and op ~= OC.M_FORPREP and 
					 op ~= OC.M_FORLOOP and op ~= OC.M_CALL and op ~= OC.M_RETURN and 
					 op ~= OC.M_HALT and op ~= OC.M_EXEC_SUB and 
					 op ~= OC.M_GETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_SETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_LOADBOOL
		safeOpMap[op] = safe
		return safe
	end

	local function findAndApply(p)
		local pairsCount = {}
		local function count(p_inner)
			for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
				local op1 = p_inner.c[i][1]
				local op2 = p_inner.c[i+1][1]
				
				if isSafeFast(op1) and isSafeFast(op2) then
					local key = (op1 * 256) + op2
					pairsCount[key] = (pairsCount[key] or 0) + 1
				end
			end
			for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do count(sp) end
		end
		count(p)

		local bestPair, maxCount = nil, 0
		for k, c in pairs(pairsCount) do
			if c > maxCount then maxCount = c; bestPair = k end
		end

		if maxCount >= 2 then
			local o2 = bestPair % 256
			local o1 = math.floor(bestPair / 256)
			
			superCount = superCount + 1
			local superName = "M_SUPER_" .. superCount
			local superVal = fop()
			OC[superName] = superVal
			reverseOC[superVal] = superName 
			superMap[superName] = {getName(o1), getName(o2)}

						local function apply(p_inner)
				local _skip_next = false
				for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
					if _skip_next then
						_skip_next = false
					elseif p_inner.c[i][1] == o1 and p_inner.c[i+1][1] == o2 then
						p_inner.c[i][1] = superVal
						_skip_next = true
					end
				end
				for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do apply(sp) end
			end
			apply(p)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	for iter = 1, 15 do
		if not findAndApply(proto) then break end
	end
	return superMap
end

--[[
    ButtonTourTeleport (LocalScript)

    Place in StarterGui or StarterPlayerScripts.

    Creates a small GUI with a "Start Tour" button. When pressed, it
    teleports the player's character to parts named _Button1, _Button2,
    ..., _Button20 (waiting 1 second between each), then finally
    teleports to a part named ExitRegion.

    Parts are searched for in workspace. Adjust FindPart() below if your
    button parts live in a specific folder/model instead of directly in
    workspace.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
----------------------------------------------------------------

local NUM_BUTTONS = 20
local WAIT_TIME = 1 -- seconds between each teleport
local EXIT_PART_NAME = "ExitRegion"

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI CREATION
----------------------------------------------------------------

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ButtonTourGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "MainFrame"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 130)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -65)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = frame

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Name = "StatusLabel"
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Ready"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
statusLabel.TextSize = 16
statusLabel.Parent = frame

local startButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
startButton.Name = "StartButton"
startButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
startButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 36)
startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 255)
startButton.Text = "Start Tour"
startButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
startButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
startButton.TextSize = 18
startButton.AutoButtonColor = true
startButton.Parent = frame

local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
buttonCorner.Parent = startButton

local restartButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
restartButton.Name = "RestartButton"
restartButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
restartButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 82)
restartButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 40)
restartButton.Text = "Restart"
restartButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
restartButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
restartButton.TextSize = 18
restartButton.AutoButtonColor = true
restartButton.Parent = frame

local restartButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
restartButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
restartButtonCorner.Parent = restartButton

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
----------------------------------------------------------------

local currentRunId = 0 -- incremented each time a (re)start happens; used to cancel stale runs

local function findPart(name)
	-- Searches the whole workspace for a part/model with this name.
	local inst = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	return inst
end

local function findHitbox(buttonInst)
	-- Given a _ButtonN instance (likely a Model), find its "Hitbox" child part.
	-- Falls back to the instance itself if it has no Hitbox child.
	if not buttonInst then
		return nil
	end

	local hitbox = buttonInst:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true)
	if hitbox and hitbox:IsA("BasePart") then
		return hitbox
	end

	return buttonInst
end

local function teleportCharacterTo(inst)
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return false
	end

	if not inst or not inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end

	-- Position on the part's top face, then nudge 0.5 studs down into it
	-- (in the part's own local space, so this works even if it's rotated).
	local topOffset = (inst.Size.Y / 2) - 0.5
	local targetCFrame = inst.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, topOffset, 0)

	hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
	return true
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- MAIN TOUR LOGIC
----------------------------------------------------------------

local function runTour()
	currentRunId = currentRunId + 1
	local myRunId = currentRunId

	startButton.Active = false
	startButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90)

	for i = 1, NUM_BUTTONS do
		if myRunId ~= currentRunId then
			return -- a newer run (restart) has taken over; stop this one
		end

		local partName = "_Button" .. i
		statusLabel.Text = "Going to " .. partName

		local part = findPart(partName)
		if part then
			local hitbox = findHitbox(part)
			teleportCharacterTo(hitbox)
		else
			warn("[ButtonTourTeleport] Could not find part named: " .. partName)
			statusLabel.Text = "Missing: " .. partName
		end

		task.wait(WAIT_TIME)
	end

	if myRunId ~= currentRunId then
		return
	end

	statusLabel.Text = "Going to " .. EXIT_PART_NAME
	local exitPart = findPart(EXIT_PART_NAME)
	if exitPart then
		local exitTarget = exitPart
		if not exitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			-- ExitRegion might be a Model; grab its PrimaryPart or first BasePart
			exitTarget = exitPart.PrimaryPart or exitPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		teleportCharacterTo(exitTarget)
	else
		warn("[ButtonTourTeleport] Could not find part named: " .. EXIT_PART_NAME)
		statusLabel.Text = "Missing: " .. EXIT_PART_NAME
	end

	if myRunId ~= currentRunId then
		return
	end

	statusLabel.Text = "Done!"
	task.wait(1)

	if myRunId == currentRunId then
		statusLabel.Text = "Ready"
		startButton.Active = true
		startButton.AutoButtonColor = true
		startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 255)
	end
end

startButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(runTour)
end)

restartButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	-- Bumping currentRunId cancels any in-progress run on its next check,
	-- then we immediately kick off a fresh one.
	task.spawn(runTour)
end)
